en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5756 - In the narration of Hamdan ibn Al-Husayn from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Walid from Ibn Bukayr from Abdullah ibn Sinan,
he said: "I asked Abu Abdullah (as), 'For what reason is the inheritance for the male
equal to the share of two females?'
Imam (as) replied: 'Because Allah (swt) has allocated the dowry (ṣadaq) for her.'"
